## Definition of done

- [ ] Implementation complete
- [ ] Tests added or updated, passing locally
- [ ] Coverage ≥ 90% (enforced in CI)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, `docs/PLAN.md` status, `docs/DECISIONS.md` if a decision was made)
- [ ] API documentation updated, or N/A (no public API yet)
- [ ] Security review: no secrets committed; SQL, schema text, and DB values treated as untrusted; DB access only through the read-only role
- [ ] Benchmark before/after included, or N/A (no behaviour change to the pipeline)
- [ ] All CI checks green
- [ ] Branch is `feature/…` or `bugfix/…`, targets `main`; commits follow Conventional Commits
